_comment: Text for the ending reveal — a leaked investor pitch by the app's founder, shown before the stats. Placeholders: {name} = player name, {seconds} = session length in whole seconds, {swipes} = right + left swipes, {matches} = all matches, {next} = queue number of the next card, {position} = queue position THE ONE was kept at. THE ONE never appears in the game — this is narrative only.

captions.intro: Dear {name} — take a deeper look at our product.
captions.harvest: You gave us {seconds} seconds of your precious time.
captions.queue: Your perfect match? We kept them from you!
captions.held: Because people who find love delete our app.
captions.closer: We can't profit from love but we can profit from the search for it.
